{{Quote|The Zarracines refused to accommodate Coruscant's envoys and on the verge of capture the entire ruling council killed themselves to avoid conversion and spite their conquerors. In retaliation, Commodore Daymont "Veracity" Praji bombed Zarracina III into radioactive winter.|Dr. Gabrel Treon, "Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes"|<ref name="Tinker" />}}
'''Daymont Praji''', also known by the nickname "'''Veracity'''," was a member of [[House Praji/Legends|House Praji]] and a [[Commodore/Legends|commodore]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|navy]] during the [[Pius Dea Era]]. In [[11,660 BBY]], when the Republic failed to capture the [[Zarracina III ruling council|ruling council]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zarracina III]], Praji ordered that the planet be subjected to [[Bombardment of Zarracina III|orbital bombardment]] in retaliation. The [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombardment]] caused the [[Speciecide|near-extinction]] of the [[Zarracine]] [[Species/Legends|species]], members of which went on to nurture a [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]]-long hatred for the Republic and House Praji.

==Biography==
{{Quote|The Republic annexed the system and the few surviving Zarracines became a nomadic species. Harboring much hatred for the destroyers of their world, they kept to themselves, although many joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems and later Nolaa Tarkona's Diversity Alliance.|Dr. Gabrel Treon, "Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes"|<ref name="Tinker" />}}
Daymont Praji, also known by the nickname "Veracity," was a member of the [[House Praji/Legends|House Praji]] [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] family who lived during the [[Pius Dea Era]],<ref name="Tinker" /> a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] between approximately [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]] and [[11,000 BBY]] when the [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentric]] [[Pius Dea]] cult controlled the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Praji served in the Republic's [[Republic Navy/Legends|naval forces]] and held the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Commodore/Legends|commodore]]. In [[11,660 BBY]], after a strategically important stable [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump point was discovered in the [[Zarracina system/Legends|Zarracina system]], the Republic attempted to gain control over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zarracina III]], which was inhabited by the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Zarracine]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. On the verge of capture by the Republic, the entire [[Zarracina III ruling council|ruling council]] of the planet committed [[Death/Legends|suicide]] in order to avoid conversion to the Pius Dea religion and to spite the would-be Republic conquerors.<ref name="Tinker" />

In response, Praji ordered Zarracina III to be [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombarded]] from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], which sent the planet into a state of [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] [[Winter/Legends|winter]]. The [[Bombardment of Zarracina III|bombardment]] also caused the [[Speciecide|near-extinction]] of the Zarracines, with the few remaining [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] adopting a nomadic existence and nurturing hatred for the Republic and the Praji family that lasted for more than ten [[Millennium/Legends|thousand years]]. In [[104 ABY]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Gabrel Treon]] mentioned Praji's role in the bombardment of Zarracina III in the article "[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes]]," published in the [[Byblos Journal of Historical Science]].<ref name="Tinker" />

==Behind the scenes==
Daymont Praji was mentioned in "[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji]]," an article authored by [[Nathan O'Keefe]] and published as part of the [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature on [[February 5]], [[2009]].<ref name="Tinker" />
